products.title: Manage products
products.newIntro: The product's URL (slug) is derived from its English name, and it will show without an image until one is defined in the catalogue.
products.seedNote: Changes here reach the store immediately. Running the seed resets the catalogue to the CSV's values — edits revert and products created here are hidden — a deliberate dev-environment reset.
products.deactivated: {{name}} is now hidden from the store. It can be returned at any time.

form.nameEnHint: The product's URL is derived from this name and cannot change after creation
form.brandNewNameEnHint: The manufacturer's official Latin form, when one exists. Empty = no Latin form
form.packageQuantityHint: Unit count — or volume in ml (drops, syrup) / weight in g (powder)
form.priceHint: In shekels. A whole number works — 190 is saved as 190.00
form.imageUrlHint: A full http(s) address of an image, or the path an upload returned. Empty = the product shows without an image
form.imageFileHint: PNG / JPEG / WebP up to 5MB. The file is stored on the server and the path fills the link field
form.uploaded: The image was uploaded and the link field was filled.
form.warningsHint: May stay empty when the manufacturer publishes no warnings
form.dietaryHint: "No claim" is the default — the product joins the matching filter only when marked "Yes"
form.goalNewHint: A new goal needs both a Hebrew and an English name. A name that already exists attaches to the existing goal
form.lowStockThresholdHint: Default 5 — the dashboard alerts when stock reaches or falls under it

duplicate.message: A similarly named product already exists under this brand: "{{name}}" ({{slug}}).
duplicate.inactiveHint: The existing product is hidden from the shop — reactivating it may be better than creating a new one.
duplicate.override: This is a different product — create it anyway

errors.PRICE_INVALID: The price must be in 00.00 format and greater than zero.
errors.STOCK_INVALID: Stock must be a whole number, zero or more.
errors.NO_FIELDS: No change was marked for saving.
errors.PACKAGE_QUANTITY_INVALID: Package quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.
errors.SLUG_UNDERIVABLE: The English name must contain Latin letters or digits to derive a URL.
errors.IMAGE_URL_INVALID: The image link must be a full http(s) address or a server upload path.
errors.IMAGE_TYPE_INVALID: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP are accepted.
errors.IMAGE_UPLOAD_REJECTED: The upload was rejected — the file may be over 5MB.
errors.CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND: The chosen category does not exist.
errors.BRAND_NOT_FOUND: The chosen brand does not exist.
errors.BRAND_CONFLICT: Pick an existing brand or enter a new company — not both.
errors.NEW_HEALTH_GOAL_INVALID: A new goal needs both a Hebrew and an English name.
errors.HEALTH_GOAL_NOT_FOUND: One of the chosen health goals does not exist.
errors.LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD_INVALID: The low-stock threshold must be a non-negative whole number
